import sys

def main():
    chars = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    even_runs = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(chars):
        j = i + 1
        while j < len(chars) and chars[j] == chars[i]:
            j += 1
        if (j - i) % 2 == 0:
            even_runs += 1
        i = j
    
    print(even_runs)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
